reason: This changes core planner logical-operator hash/equality generation, including shared generated code and multiple foundational operators (`LogicalJoin`, `LogicalAggregation`, `LogicalDataSource`, `LogicalExpand`, `logical_schema_producer`). Hash/equality semantics in optimizer internals are central and can silently affect plan memoization, deduplication, rule application, and plan-selection behavior across many queries. The scope is not a narrow bugfix; it modifies common planner machinery and deserves a deeper pass for potential high-severity optimizer-correctness regressions.
